info.title: What is Adachi to Shimamura?
info.subtitle: An introduction for new readers
paragraphs: Adachi to Shimamura (安達としまむら) is a Japanese yuri light novel series written by Hitoma Iruma. The series began serialization in Dengeki Bunko Magazine in October 2012, with its first volume published under the Dengeki Bunko imprint in March 2013. The original light novel illustrations were provided by Non for Volumes 1–8, followed by Shizue Kaneko for Volume 9 and Raemz from Volume 10 onward. Non continues to be credited with the character designs.

Sakura Adachi and Hougetsu Shimamura are first-year high school students who meet while skipping class and begin spending time together on the second floor of their school's gymnasium. The two gradually become friends, talking about television, cooking, and other everyday subjects, occasionally playing table tennis, and developing a routine around their time together. For Adachi, however, the friendship gradually begins to feel like something more. As she becomes increasingly conscious of her feelings for Shimamura, she struggles with jealousy, uncertainty, and the difficulty of expressing what she wants from their relationship.

The series follows the gradual development of Adachi and Shimamura's relationship through their everyday lives, with the story frequently exploring events through their individual thoughts and perspectives. Their relationship changes over time as they become more open with one another and begin to understand what their feelings mean. The light novel series currently consists of 14 main volumes and 2 side-story volumes, alongside other related material.

Adachi to Shimamura has also received multiple adaptations, including the 2016 manga illustrated by Mani, the manga adaptation illustrated by Moke Yuzuhara, and a 12-episode television anime produced by Tezuka Productions that aired from October to December 2020. The wider series also includes drama CDs, additional short stories, and other supplementary releases.
